items.action: Inventory every PHP instance (including legacy 5/7 branches), back up, and apply vendor builds the moment they land today; EOL branches need backports or upgrades to a supported PHP 8 line. Ask hosting providers when they'll roll the update out.
items.details: Embargo details leaked Oct 20 alongside a claimed exploit tool ('PHP2Shell', credited to Calif.IO) said to work against every PHP release from 5.4.0. The flaws affect PHP 5.4 and later — every web server running PHP, including WordPress, Magento, WooCommerce, Shopware and Drupal. PHP only supports 8.2+, so servers on 8.1 or older get no official fix. No in-the-wild exploitation observed yet; watchTowr confirmed the bugs are real and reproducible.
items.summary: PHP ships an emergency out-of-band release today fixing two remote code execution flaws in PHP core, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2 each; watchTowr rates them 10.0).
items.title: PHP emergency out-of-band release: two critical core RCE flaws

items.action: Patch Fortinet and BeyondTrust Remote Support immediately; hunt for PEERSTITCH implant indicators on FortiOS devices.
items.details: CVE-2025-61624 is a path traversal in Fortinet products exploited by PEERSTITCH malware to compromise 500+ firewalls via the FortiOS auto-script engine, deploying a stealth implant. CVE-2026-102764 is an authentication bypass in BeyondTrust Remote Support enabling initial access, privilege escalation and lateral movement.
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2025-61624 (Fortinet path traversal, exploited by PEERSTITCH malware on 500+ firewalls) and CVE-2026-102764 (BeyondTrust Remote Support auth bypass) to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
items.title: CISA adds Fortinet and BeyondTrust flaws to KEV catalog

items.action: Patch PAN-OS immediately if not done; hunt for suspicious VPN sessions and RMM tool installs.
items.details: Unit 42 (reported Oct 20) confirmed Spikey Scorpius (Qilin) and Tarnished Scorpius (INC) exploiting the flaw to establish unauthorized VPN sessions, bypass MFA, then recon with RMM tools and move laterally via RDP/SMB. ReliaQuest independently reported active exploitation by Qilin and Settra.
items.summary: Qilin and INC ransomware operators are actively exploiting CVE-2026-0257 (CVSS 7.8, PAN-OS/Prisma Access authentication bypass, patched May 2026) to bypass MFA, establish unauthorized VPN sessions and move laterally.
items.title: Qilin and INC exploiting PAN-OS flaw CVE-2026-0257 to bypass MFA

items.details: Asensus Surgical (US medical-device maker, part of KARL STORZ since 2024) has not publicly confirmed the incident. No encryption confirmed; no ransom figure published.
items.summary: The 'Dark Project' ransomware group listed Asensus Surgical on its leak site on Oct 20, claiming exfiltration of 600 GB / 85,000+ files including employee personal documents, research data and internal records. Unverified — no company confirmation.
items.title: Dark Project claims Asensus Surgical breach (600 GB)

items.details: On Oct 7, attackers used stolen credentials to access a cloud-based development environment. No credit cards exposed; no evidence of misuse as of Oct 16. Reported to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission on Oct 11.
items.summary: Nikkei Inc. (owner of the Financial Times) disclosed its third incident in ~30 days: attackers accessed a cloud development environment, exposing 1.83M records, 150,000 containing PII (names, addresses, emails, phone numbers, DOBs).
items.title: Nikkei discloses third breach in a month — 1.83M records exposed

items.details: Details on ransomware vs. intrusion were not established in reporting seen so far.
items.summary: Ahold Delhaize disclosed a cyberattack on Oct 20 disrupting services across multiple US and European regions. Supply-chain exposure for retail and supplier partners.
items.title: Ahold Delhaize cyberattack disrupts services across US and Europe

items.details: No company statement found; monitor for a data-leak publication before treating as confirmed.
items.summary: The INC Ransom group listed centralrogers.com (a US organization) as a victim on its leak site on Oct 20. Unverified leak-site claim.
items.title: INC Ransom claims centralrogers.com

items.action: Treat any SBI-related loan/account data as potentially circulating; watch for targeted phishing and fraudulent loan applications using KYC documents.
items.details: This follows an earlier claim flagged Oct 16 by OSINT account CyberPulse56 of a threat actor 'Siriusim' claiming ~375,000 CSV rows + 2,722 PDFs allegedly linked to SBI — authenticity unverified and a separate, unconfirmed claim.
items.summary: State Bank of India reported on Oct 21 that a cyberattack led to 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information being disclosed on the dark web.
items.title: SBI reports cyberattack; 3,897 customer records on dark web

items.details: The claims remain unverified; SBI had not responded to queries and it is unclear whether the records are genuine or originated from SBI's systems. This is separate from the 3,897-record incident SBI itself reported.
items.summary: On Oct 20, Indian media reported that cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse56 flagged a hacker group named 'Siriusim' claiming ~3.75 lakh SBI-linked records in CSV format plus 2,722 PDFs (personal details, loan applications, account-opening forms). Unverified allegation.
items.title: Hacker group 'Siriusim' claims 3.75 lakh SBI records (unverified)
